name: Can I prevent water heater leaks through maintenance?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent water heater leaks through maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, regular maintenance can significantly reduce the likelihood of water heater leaks. This includes annually flushing the tank to remove sediment buildup, which can corrode the tank and cause leaks. It's also beneficial to periodically inspect the pressure relief valve and connections for any signs of wear or corrosion. For residents in the Las Vegas Valley, the hard water can exacerbate sediment issues, making regular flushing even more critical for prolonging your water heater's life and preventing leaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular maintenance, such as annual tank flushing and inspecting valves/connections, helps prevent leaks. Hard water in Las Vegas makes flushing especially important.
